lines.zh: 我走在前面，没人敢并肩。
lines.en: I walk in front. No one dares walk beside me.
My cloak drags the ground, loudly.
My boots sink into the soil.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，是因为没必要。
lines.en: I do not walk fast. There is no need.
My armor clicks at the ribs.
Chin up, my stride widens.
One pass along this road is enough.
I survey my own domain.
The wind lifts my cloak. I let it.
My shoulders sway, and the plates knock.
I walk toward the ki I sense.
Standing, arms crossed.

lines.zh: 我从来不看脚下的东西。
lines.en: I never look at things below me.

lines.zh: 这一带，没有值得出手的。
lines.en: Nothing here is worth my hand.
Few words. My eyes said it.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸肩甲上的凹痕。
lines.en: I touch the dent in my pauldron.
Ki presses around my body.

lines.zh: 地上尘土绕着我的脚转。
lines.en: Dust circles my feet.
My chin has not come down once.
Waiting for a worthy opponent.
Wind fills my cloak.
I gave a short snort.
My fingers tap my arm.
I stand straight as a stele.
This sky grows dull with looking.
You are in my way.

lines.zh: 你这种水平，也想挑战我？
lines.en: At your level, you challenge me?

lines.zh: 我一眼就看穿你的实力。
lines.en: One glance and I read your strength.
Don't blink. I want a good look at you.
Kneel, or get out.
Your ki is an ant's.
That outfit is appalling.
Do not expect praise from me.
The ground you stand on is mine.
You are still standing. Remarkable.
Do not think I respect you.
You cannot even hold that blade steady.
Are you not done looking?
Hmph. Another one of these.
One chance. Withdraw.
Take one step forward. Try it.
You dared to hit me.
That was a cheap blow.
I took half a step. That is enough.
A plate has shattered.
Blood from my brow, in my eye.
Pain? Shut your mouth.
I remember that punch.
My pride does not permit me to fall.
Try that again if you dare.
I will take it back tenfold.
You offer such a thing to me?
I am unimpressed by such things.

lines.zh: 你要是想讨好我，还差得远。
lines.en: If you mean to please me, you are far off.
Training resources. Those I value.
Put that on the table.

lines.zh: 我的骄傲，不是拿来换的。
lines.en: My pride is not for trade.
A bean? Interesting.
Do not fob me off with food.
I want greater power.

lines.zh: 你这点诚意，瞒不过我的眼。
lines.en: That little sincerity does not fool me.
Move. This road is mine.
You hit me. The fault is yours.
I will not shift a step.

lines.zh: 你有胆量，可惜力气不够。
lines.en: You have nerve, but not strength.
Get back. Do not crowd me.

lines.zh: 你的肩甲刮到我的披风了。
lines.en: Your pauldron scraped my cloak.
That force is not worth dodging.
Do not grovel at my feet.
See? I did not even sway.
Get out of my road.

lines.zh: 我是王子，血统不容玷污。
lines.en: I am a prince. My bloodline is not to be sullied.
The topic is beneath my words.
My dignity does not permit it.

lines.zh: 先把实力练到我的程度。
lines.en: First reach my level of strength.
There are weightier matters.
Do not simper in front of me.
You think I would agree?
Move your hand away.
This is simply dull.
I cannot be bothered with refuse.
A crook of my finger and it rises.
Let me see what it is.
Things on the ground smell foul.
This orb, I keep.
Bending would cheapen me.
A coin. Beneath mention.
I tossed it away.
If you want it, take it.
Do not bother me with trivia.
You cannot slip my sight.
Galick Gun, charged.
Aerial combo, ready.
I want you to remember today.
Your position is worth my hand.
I will win this.
Do not think you can escape.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的骄傲，容不下第二个人。
lines.en: Saiyan pride leaves no room for a second target.
I need no help.

lines.zh: 我的骄傲，压在这场战斗上。
lines.en: My pride rides on this fight.
I open at full power.
You are finished this time.
I close in step by step.
I know your breathing now.
His left shoulder twitches.
The Galick Gun still spins in my hand.
He is cornered at the wall.
This fight needs no haste.
I raise a hand, and he retreats.
I am calculating the distance.
He thinks I only fly.
The blast's aim is true.
Two steps closer.
His ki is breaking up.
I wait for that gap.
I have drilled this a thousand times.

lines.zh: 我的气弹已经封住你的退路。
lines.en: My ki blast has sealed off your way back.
Good. That is enough.
This exact instant.

lines.zh: 一记直拳，打在他的胸口。
lines.en: A straight punch to his chest.
Aerial combo, continuing.
The blasts skim the ground.
I drive a knee into his chest.
An elbow knocks his blade aside.
He blocked. His hands shake.
That one pushes him back three blocks.
Galick Gun. Take it.
I step on his shield.
He falls. I stop.
A fist punches through armor.
I shove him away.
I turn in the air and kick again.
So this is all you have.
I pull back and blow on my knuckles.
I have arrived. Everyone look up.
You should recognize this ki.
My cloak falls, and the dust parts.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的王子，站在这里。
lines.en: The prince of Saiyans stands here.
Which of you wants to be first?
The air here is too comfortable.
One sweep of my eyes. No strong ones.
I have held this power too long.
I will visit your temple later.
Stand tall. Do not earn my contempt.
I need no welcome.

lines.zh: 我从天上来，踩碎了屋顶。
lines.en: I came from the sky and cracked a roof.
The wind stops. Even dust holds still.
I returned to win.

lines.zh: 我先说清楚，我不会留手。
lines.en: To be clear: I will not hold back.

lines.zh: 今天，我要拿走属于我的东西。
lines.en: Today I take what is mine.
Do not block my road.
Then let the fight begin.
Fire burns my armor. A joke.
I land on one knee.
I am not suited to fighting underwater.
The blast flips my cloak.
An arrow skims my face.
That was no ki technique.

lines.zh: 饿的时候，气也提不上来。
lines.en: When starving, my ki will not rise.

lines.zh: 电打在肩甲上，一路麻下去。
lines.en: Lightning on my pauldron, numbness down my side.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我也没有立足之地。
lines.en: Even I have no footing in the void.
